title: Last Seats in the Lagoon
influence: The supplied Titanic survey record grounds rigid lifeboats that move forward, backward, or sideways without rotating; compulsory boarding at rope-marked sides when a free seat is available; and an all-passengers-seated outcome.
transformation: Original procedural 2D lagoon geometry, boats, reefs, passenger positions, capacity ledger, route generator, direct-drag and direction-pad surfaces, transcript replay, and controllability profiles. The source game's art, levels, code, and assets are not copied.
asset_policy: No third-party images, audio, fonts, code, or presentation assets are redistributed. Shipped visuals are original HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python.
source_limitations: The commercial source page confirms the game family and the supplied survey record supplies the rule details; this benchmark is an original transformation rather than a source-level reproduction.
